provenance.asset_description: Tade, artist Fabio Di Bernardi: Tade, a known ally of Elovai, stalks forward with guns drawn and shoulder-mounted ice cannon primed. They’re a nonbinary ysoki, mutated by the conversion process into a mindless servitor of the Wreck. They wear dark combat gear, have a blade on their tail, and their gray fur is patchy with molecular degradation that looks like rust
